_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Simulation Paper. Photonics-based Self-Interference Cancellation (SIC) for Full-Duplex mmWave ISAC. Analyzed in OptiSystem.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Figure 1: Self-interference schematic. Figure 2: System Setup (DPMZM for SIC). Figure 3: Numerical results (SIC depth 43.7 dB, PSLR 15.35 dB).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Full-Duplex mmWave ISAC enabled by Photonics. Innovation: Optical-domain Self-Interference Cancellation (SIC) using a DPMZM to cancel the TX leakage at the RX.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: Zero BER (simulated). Sensing: PSLR 15.35 dB. SIC Depth: 43.7 dB.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Enabling Co-frequency Co-time Full Duplex (CCFD) for ISAC by solving the self-interference problem in the optical domain.

bibliographic.title: Photonics-enabled full-duplex millimeter-wave integrated sensing and communication
bibliographic.authors: Can Wang, Zhidong Lyu, Lu Zhang, Xianbin Yu

application.scenario_description: Full-duplex ISAC node doubling spectrum utilization.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Optical domain Self-Interference Cancellation (SIC) using DPMZM for wideband mmWave ISAC.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Self-interference in full-duplex systems limits ISAC performance.

receiver.notes: PD2 for reception after DPMZM-based SIC.

channel_fibre.notes: Fiber utilized for generation/processing, wireless for transmission.

comm_metrics.notes: 10 Gbps (10 GHz BW BPSK). Zero BER simulated.

sensing_metrics.notes: 30ns delay simulated = 4.5m range. 10 GHz bandwidth implies ~1.5cm resolution. PSLR 15.35 dB.

tradeoff.notes: SIC depth of 43.7 dB enables full duplex.
